reconciliations.reason: AMD's data sheets state the per-link figure and its direction, and the platform data sheet calls 896 GB/s bidirectional, so the public statements that scope and direction are unstated were wrong and are corrected. The same documents label 896 GB/s as a ring-of-8 aggregate and never call it per-GPU, so the IDE-008 resolution, which rested on arithmetic, overstated the evidence and the issue is reopened.
reconciliations.original_interpretation: IDE-004: AMD's 896 GB/s 'P2P ring peak aggregate' has no stated direction, and whether it applies per GPU or per platform is not stated. IDE-008: resolved as a per-GPU, both-direction aggregate.

new_evidence.locator: Platform data sheet: "a peak aggregate bidirectional Infinity Fabric bandwidth of 896 GB/s"
new_evidence.observation: AMD states the direction explicitly. The sentence says the platform connects all GPUs in the 8-node ring at this bandwidth.

new_evidence.locator: Platform data sheet table: "7x 128 GB/s per GPU"; "Ring of 8 aggregate bandwidth"
new_evidence.observation: AMD gives the per-GPU link set and labels the 896 GB/s figure as a ring-of-8 aggregate.

new_evidence.locator: Data sheet: "direct connectivity of 128 GB/s bidirectional bandwidth between each GPU"
White paper: "One of the links is multi-purpose and can be configured to act as a x16 PCIe® Gen 5"
new_evidence.observation: AMD describes eight x16 link interfaces per GPU, one usable as the PCIe host link.

new_evidence.locator: CDNA 4 paper: "Each GPU offers >1TB/s of communication bandwidth within a node"
new_evidence.observation: For the later MI350 generation, AMD's '(8 GPUs)' P2P figure of 1,008 GB/s is described as per-GPU bandwidth; this is a labelling convention, not an MI300X statement.

sources_examined_not_supporting.observation: The editorial review of PR #18 cited endnote MI350-007 on printed page 21 as stating 896 GB/s per GPU OAM module. The edition retrieved on 2026-11-11 (21 pages, revision dated 9/28/2026) contains endnotes MI350-002, -005, -051, -052 and -053 only, and no 896 GB/s figure; the cited statement could not be verified.

reconciliations.reconciled_interpretation: AMD states that 896 GB/s is a bidirectional peak aggregate and that each MI300X has seven 128 GB/s bidirectional Infinity Fabric links to its peers. Seven times 128 GB/s is 896 GB/s, and AMD uses the same '(8 GPUs)' label for a later figure it describes as per-GPU, so the per-GPU reading is the better-supported one. No reviewed MI300X document states it, and the platform data sheet's wording reads as a ring-level figure, so the scope stays unresolved.
